result.entry_context_assessment: BUY is accepted after break-bar open near the horizontal Entry, into an already lifting tape; the immediate post-entry path is continuation higher rather than an instant failed break or entry-level rejection.
result.path_anatomy: Break-bar open → actual BUY fill near Entry → strong favorable extension well above entry and below TP → prolonged elevated chop above entry → multi-bar breakdown through entry → stop hit at SL with realized R=-1.273.
result.book_trace_relevance: The full-break-bar book score is mildly positive (early +0.025, late +0.043, score +0.055) and does not visually flag this path as adverse at acceptance; the eventual stop-out is therefore not explained by a strongly negative on-chart book discriminator.
result.exit_geometry_assessment: SL is a fixed horizontal under entry; TP is far above and never engaged; the purple X lands on SL after a long favorable excursion, so the realized geometry is full giveback from deep MFE into a full stop loss.
result.failure_mechanism: The trade first behaves like a continuing breakout winner, then reverses over a long holding window and runs from far above entry down through Entry to the stop, converting prior unrealized gain into a matched BUY loss without TP interaction.
